def check_feature(name, street_direction):
    if isinstance(name, str) and isinstance(street_direction, str):
        name = name.lower()
        street_direction = street_direction.lower()
        return 1 if name in street_direction or street_direction in name else 0
    elif isinstance(name, dict) and isinstance(street_direction, dict):
        name_keys = name.keys()
        street_direction_keys = street_direction.keys()
        return 1 if set(name_keys).intersection(set(street_direction_keys)) else 0
    else:
        return 0

name = input()
street_direction = input()

print(check_feature(name, street_direction))
